segments.name: Liver and viral diseases
segments.description: Clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing drug candidates for liver diseases and viral infections, including chronic HBV, MASH, obesity and coronavirus infections.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment which is focused on discovering and developing drug candidates in both liver and viral diseases.

revenueModel.text: The company generates revenue through license and collaboration agreements and has never generated revenue from product sales.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's reportable segment primarily generates revenue through its license and collaboration agreements (see Notes 9 and 10).
